verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage publishes a per-endpoint API reference covering monitoring, exports, audit, roles, transactions and customer lookup. It also ships its own Postman collection with runnable requests and a downloadable OpenAPI schema, which a probe confirmed (OpenAPI 3.0.3, retrievable unauthenticated). No evidence shows the reference pages themselves are interactive or offer an in-browser 'try it' console, so runnable examples rely on the separate Postman collection. Missing for 10: documented in-browser interactive/try-it console in the reference, embedded runnable code samples per endpoint, independent hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
